fals001.question: Is current observable information sufficient to justify continued L0–L1 research?
fals001.summary: No L0–L2 (price-derived) hypothesis family achieved promotion under the current validation framework. The next evidence-based research step is to evaluate whether additional observable information (Open Interest and Funding) improves decision quality before considering higher-cost market microstructure data.
interpretations: Evidence is insufficient to distinguish between the plausible explanations below — do not assume a single cause
- Weak formulation — implementations may be poor (not ruled out)
- Insufficient observable information — all families used price-derived features; OI/funding (L2) untested
- Validation conservatism — strict promotion gates increase false negatives; no promotion ≠ no signal
- Market/timeframe dependence — phenomenon may exist on different horizon or universe
Some holdout slices showed weak signal — consistent with validation conservatism or weak formulation, not uniquely insufficient information
Case C always possible: phenomenon may exist on different timeframe than 15m or outside crypto_futures

nextSteps.action: Integrate free L2: OI + funding — genuinely new information, not another OHLCV transform
Retest price-derived families with L2 features before any L3 microstructure investment
Only consider L3 historical order book if OI/funding measurably improve discrimination
